# Trump approval rating slips among Alabama voters, new poll finds

Jennifer Lindahl Bonnie Bolden Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Montgomery Advertiser

Updated Sept. 3, 2026, 1:50 p.m. CT

President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Alabama voters has slipped in recent weeks, according to the latest Civiqs polling, even as he continues to hold a positive overall rating in the state. [...] The latest figures show 48% of Alabama voters approve of Trump’s job performance, compared with 42% who disapprove. Another 10% neither approve nor disapprove.

That marks a five-point drop in approval since early August, when 53% of Alabama voters approved of Trump’s performance and 40% disapproved.
